main_findings: Existing q30 generic rotation can be removed after refitting: 32 generic rotations are functionally feasible; total cost is worse because synthesis margin shrinks.
Actual new Boolean phase basis q42 enlarges min margin by about 44 percent but the extra generic rotation costs more than it saves.
The file identifier walsh32 is historical; its new parity reduces to existing q34 because q21 is identically zero. It is not evidence that a new independent Walsh basis was needed.
For unchanged arithmetic and Q, generic rotation count >=35 cannot beat e46 even with a perfect phase approximation under the official equal-error synthesis model.
score_claim: No score improvement found. Candidate scores are predictions using unchanged arithmetic upstream average, not new Kaggle scores.
